content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Portland

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The CAPM credential requires a secondary degree and completion of project management education — but no prior work experience. If you hold a high school diploma, associate degree, or equivalent, you're ready to start. This makes CAPM ideal for career changers and professionals new to project management.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp-style course. You'll engage with active certified practitioners over intensive sessions, covering all CAPM knowledge domains. The flexible schedule accommodates Portland professionals balancing work and training. Upon completion, you'll receive your contact-hour certificate.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with the Project Management Institute and apply for the CAPM credential using your contact-hour certificate. You'll pay the PMI exam fee at this stage. PMI verifies your eligibility and confirms your application status within a defined window.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and study guidance to reinforce your knowledge. You'll schedule your proctored CAPM exam through PMI's testing partner. The exam tests your understanding of project management fundamentals across initiation, planning, execution, and closing.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning CAPM, you'll renew every three years by earning professional development units (PDUs) through training, certifications, or project work. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses to keep your credential current and support your career advancement.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
